note: F09 source of truth for material properties (ADR-010).
Room-temperature handbook/datasheet values for bulk material — NOT as-built
build-orientation knockdowns). docs/materials.md mirrors this file for
RAG citations; tests/test_materials.py asserts the two stay in sync.
Canonical ids are lowercase alphanumeric; aliases are matched after

materials.note: Workhorse aluminum alloy: good machinability and weldability, moderate strength. The repo default for the brake pedal.

sources.yield: MatWeb / MMPDS: 6061-T6 compressive/tensile yield Rp0.2 = 276 MPa (RT)

materials.note: High-strength aerospace aluminum; ~1.8x the yield of 6061-T6 at similar density, but lower fracture toughness and poor weldability.

sources.yield: MatWeb / MMPDS: 7075-T6 tensile yield Rp0.2 = 503 MPa (RT)

materials.note: Best strength-to-weight of the table; ~56% denser than aluminum but 3.2x the yield. High material + machining cost; the classic lattice/AM material.

sources.elasticity: MatWeb datasheet: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 annealed (room temperature)
sources.yield: MatWeb / MMPDS: Ti-6Al-4V annealed tensile yield Rp0.2 = 880 MPa (RT)

materials.note: Laser-sintered polymer: cheapest per part and lightest, but E is ~38x lower than aluminum — deflections leave the small-strain regime, so scaled deflection is NOT VERIFIED. Moisture-dependent properties.

sources.elasticity: MatWeb / EOS PA12 datasheet: tensile modulus ~1.8 GPa (dry, RT)
sources.yield: EOS/MatWeb PA12: tensile yield ~45 MPa (dry, RT)

materials.note: FreeCAD's generic steel card (matches the cantilever defaults in this repo); yield is typical mild steel (S235), not defined by the FreeCAD card itself.

sources.elasticity: FreeCAD material database: Steel-Generic (E=210 GPa, nu=0.30)
sources.yield: Typical mild steel S235 yield = 250 MPa (engineering standard value)
